title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Percentage Form of the 2026-27 Late Payment Fee
content:
**Clause.** Under the board-approved 2026-27 late payment fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, the form of the fee follows the month's tuition charge, as posted on the enrollment's billing history:

- **Full month with a tuition charge of at least 100.00:** the fee is the larger of the base late fee and 10 percent of that tuition charge.
- **Half-month first month:** the fee is 10 percent of that tuition charge.
- **Any other full month** (a tuition charge below 100.00): the fee is the base late fee.

A half-month first month is a first month billed at the half-month rate because care started on or after the half-month start day. Every other month is a full month.

## Condition table

| Proration of the month's tuition charge | Tuition charge | Fee form |
|---|---|---|
| full month | at least 100.00 | the larger of the base late fee and 10 percent of the charge |
| full month | below 100.00 | the base late fee |
| half month | any amount | 10 percent of the charge |

## Worked cases (hypothetical base late fee of 9.00)

| Month | Tuition charge | 10 percent of the charge | Fee form gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| full | 140.00 | 14.00 | 14.00 (larger than 9.00) |
| full | 100.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| full | 99.99 | not used | 9.00 |
| full | 112.00 | 11.20 | 11.20 |
| half | 71.00 | 7.10 | 7.10 |
